primary.title: TDS statements can be filed directly through TRACES portal: What changed from tax year 2026–27? Expert explains
primary.summary: TDS and TCS compliance has moved to an online filing setup from Tax Year 2026-27 onwards, changing how deductors submit quarterly statements. The process brings fresh forms, a separate compliance environment, and updated filing steps. Here’s what deductors need to know.
